subject: Post-call: volume & budget confirm + finance owner for pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintech-ventures.com>, Samira Patel <samira@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: confirm economic buyer and finance owner

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks I promised:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use: user-facing personalization and real-time recommendations (text-only calls).
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state ~250M tokens/month in Q3, with peak batches up to ~1B tokens/month as feature usage ramps.
- Per-user estimate: ~2k tokens/active-user/month; target MAUs ~125k first year.

Unit economics & target pricing we discussed
- Internal goal you mentioned: target ~ $900/1M tokens effective unit cost (predictable).
- Rough Redwood ballpark (for discussion): hosted API with committed volumes ~ $1,000/1M tokens; Dedicated 12-mo commit could be ~ $700–$750/1M tokens depending on quantization and batching.
- Example calc: 250M tokens/mo => 250 * $1,000/1M = $250k/mo (hosted list/committed). If you hit 1B tokens/mo => $1.0M/mo at $1,000/1M; Dedicated commit can materially reduce that.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and who will sign finance/contract approvals? (Name + email)
2) Confirm whether you want a hosted-committed quote vs a Dedicated capacity proposal. We can produce both; Dedicated needs a bit more infra detail (throughput SLOs).
3) If budget target is $900/1M tokens, confirm that so we can prioritize the Dedicated scenario and run final numbers.

I'll pull together a short pricing scenarios deck and a Dedicated throughput estimate for your volumes (will share shortly). Rishi (cc) will run the Dedicated capacity estimate; Connor / Neha — I'm looping you for any contracting/finance flags.

Attachments: discovery-notes-ftv-20260302.md (call notes)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintech-ventures.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@clearsight.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintech-ventures.com>, David Lin <david.lin@fintech-ventures.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: confirm economic buyer and finance owner

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the items you asked for:

- Economic buyer: Priya Sharma, VP Finance (priya.sharma@fintech-ventures.com). She'll need the model that shows monthly committed spend by tier and expected savings under Dedicated.
- Finance approver / budget owner: David Lin, Director of Finance (david.lin@fintech-ventures.com). He and Priya will run the final cost vs. benefit with procurement.
- Target unit: Our internal target is indeed around $900/1M tokens for predictability. If you can show a path to that with a 12-month commit, we'll prioritize moving forward.

We prefer a short call with finance next week (15-30 min) to review the scenarios. Available windows: Tue 2026-03-09 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-03-10 14:00-15:00 PT.

Also copying Samira from our ML infra partner team — they may want to validate throughput requirements for Dedicated.

Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Product, FinTech Ventures
alex.morgan@fintech-ventures.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintech-ventures.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samira Patel <samira@clearsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: confirm economic buyer and finance owner

Perfect – thanks for confirming, Alex. I'll block Tue 03/09 10:00 PT for a 30-min finance review (sending calendar invite).

Rishi / Connor / Neha —
- Rishi: can you build two scenarios (hosted committed vs Dedicated 12-mo commit) showing per-1M token unit cost, assumed quantization savings, and expected monthly spend at 250M and 1B tokens? Put a simple sensitivity table (tokens on rows, $/1M on columns). Aim to have a first draft by EOD Tue 03/03 so I can share with FinTech ahead of the 03/09 call.
- Neha: FYI on contracting tempo — if we put a Dedicated 12-mo commit in front of them, what are the typical approvals and legal lead times you’d expect? Any docs you want me to pre-share with Priya/David?

Attachments I'll share now: redwood_pricing_scenarios_v1.pdf (initial take). I will iterate after Rishi's numbers.

Thanks team — short, tight prep will help sell this.

Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: confirm economic buyer and finance owner

Marissa — attaching the quick run (see redwood_pricing_scenarios_v1.pdf). Notes:
- Hosted committed: baseline $1,000/1M tokens (with 3-mo notice for scale adjustments). At 250M tokens/mo => ~$250k/mo.
- Dedicated 12-mo commit: with targeted quantization + batching gains, conservative estimate $680/1M tokens; aggressive estimate $600/1M at full optimization. At 1B tokens/mo that is ~$680k/mo (conservative) vs $1.0M/mo hosted.
- Assumptions listed in appendix: 8-bit quantization available for the chosen model, steady-state batching efficiency ~30% token-cost reduction, 99th percentile latency SLOs maintained.

Neha — please advise if we should include a standard credit hold clause or incremental payment schedule for the Dedicated proposal.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
(Attachments referenced: redwood_pricing_scenarios_v1.pdf, discovery-notes-ftv-20260302.md)
